text: What's up, sunshine?
ipa: /wˈʌts ˈʌp sˈʌnʃˌaɪn/
vi: Dạo này thế nào, nắng vàng?

text: I am feeling fine.
ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm fˈilɪŋ fˈaɪn/
vi: Tôi cảm thấy ổn.

text: Thanks to Miss Castellanos, Miss Ray, and all of my besties,
ipa: /θˈæŋks tˈu mˈɪs kɑsteɪlˈɑnoʊz mˈɪs ɹˈeɪ ənd ˈɔl ˈʌv mˈaɪ besties/
vi: Nhờ có cô Castellanos, cô Ray, và tất cả những người bạn thân nhất của tôi,

text: or shall I say vesties, at Baldwin in Austin, Texas.
ipa: /ˈɔɹ ʃˈæl ˈaɪ sˈeɪ vesties ˈæt bˈɔldwən ɪn ˈɔstən tˈɛksəs/
vi: hoặc tôi nên nói là vesties, tại Baldwin ở Austin, Texas.

text: Thumbs up for the creativity with each of your thumb prints.
ipa: /θˈʌmz ˈʌp fˈɔɹ ðə kɹˌieɪtˈɪvəti wˈɪð ˈitʃ ˈʌv jˈɔɹ θˈʌm pɹˈɪnts/
vi: Tuyệt vời cho sự sáng tạo với mỗi dấu vân tay của bạn.

text: And this, impeccable.
ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˌɪmpˈɛkəbəl/
vi: Và cái này, hoàn hảo.

text: I am Coy Wire, it's time to shine with your CNN 10 minutes of news.
ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm kˈɔɪ wˈaɪɚ ˈɪts tˈaɪm tˈu ʃˈaɪn wˈɪð jˈɔɹ sˈiˈɛnˈɛn 10 mˈɪnəts ˈʌv nˈuz/
vi: Tôi là Coy Wire, đã đến lúc tỏa sáng với 10 phút tin tức của CNN.

text: We begin in Ohio, where a hazardous situation has been unfolding
ipa: /wˈi bɪɡˈɪn ɪn oʊhˈaɪoʊ wˈɛɹ ə hˈæzɚdəs sˌɪtʃuˈeɪʃən hˈæz bˈɪn ənfˈoʊldɪŋ/
vi: Chúng ta bắt đầu ở Ohio, nơi một tình huống nguy hiểm đang diễn ra

text: after a chemical tank exploded in Toledo.
ipa: /ˈæftɚ ə kˈɛməkəl tˈæŋk ɪksplˈoʊdəd ɪn təlˈidoʊ/
vi: sau khi một bể hóa chất phát nổ ở Toledo.

text: The blast Tuesday night came after a chemical leak,
ipa: /ðə blˈæst tˈuzdi nˈaɪt kˈeɪm ˈæftɚ ə kˈɛməkəl lˈik/
vi: Vụ nổ tối thứ Ba xảy ra sau một vụ rò rỉ hóa chất,

text: forcing hundreds of people to evacuate their homes,
ipa: /fˈɔɹsɪŋ hˈʌndɹədz ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɪvˈækjəˌeɪt ðˈɛɹ hˈoʊmz/
vi: buộc hàng trăm người phải sơ tán khỏi nhà của họ,

text: while others within several miles were told to shelter indoors because of concerns about toxic fumes.
ipa: /wˈaɪl ˈʌðɚz wɪðˈɪn sˈɛvɹəl mˈaɪlz wˈɝ tˈoʊld tˈu ʃˈɛltɚ ˈɪndˌɔɹz bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv kənsˈɝnz əbˈaʊt tˈɑksɪk fjˈumz/
vi: trong khi những người khác trong phạm vi vài dặm được yêu cầu trú ẩn trong nhà vì lo ngại về khói độc.

text: Some residents said that the chemical haze
ipa: /sˈʌm ɹˈɛzɪdənts sˈɛd ðˈæt ðə kˈɛməkəl hˈeɪz/
vi: Một số cư dân cho biết làn khói hóa chất

text: was so thick they initially thought there was a fire.
ipa: /wˈɑz sˈoʊ θˈɪk ðˈeɪ ˌɪnˈɪʃəli θˈɔt ðˈɛɹ wˈɑz ə fˈaɪɚ/
vi: dày đến mức ban đầu họ nghĩ có cháy.

text: I assumed it was a house fire.
ipa: /ˈaɪ əsˈumd ˈɪt wˈɑz ə hˈaʊs fˈaɪɚ/
vi: Tôi đã cho rằng đó là một vụ cháy nhà.

text: And when I opened up the door and and and person peeked out,
ipa: /ənd wˈɛn ˈaɪ ˈoʊpənd ˈʌp ðə dˈɔɹ ənd ənd ənd pˈɝsən pˈikt ˈaʊt/
vi: Và khi tôi mở cửa ra và và và người đó ló đầu ra,

text: I realized it was something different, and that's when I grabbed my phone.
ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈiəlˌaɪzd ˈɪt wˈɑz sˈʌmθɪŋ dˈɪfɚənt ənd ðˈæts wˈɛn ˈaɪ ɡɹˈæbd mˈaɪ fˈoʊn/
vi: Tôi nhận ra đó là một thứ gì đó khác, và đó là lúc tôi lấy điện thoại của mình.

text: And then when my nose started burning, I knew exactly it was definitely something different.
ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn wˈɛn mˈaɪ nˈoʊz stˈɑɹtɪd bˈɝnɪŋ ˈaɪ nˈu ɪɡzˈæktli ˈɪt wˈɑz dˈɛfənətli sˈʌmθɪŋ dˈɪfɚənt/
vi: Và rồi khi mũi tôi bắt đầu bỏng rát, tôi biết chính xác đó chắc chắn là một thứ gì đó khác biệt.

text: It was a smell.
ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz ə smˈɛl/
vi: Đó là một mùi hương.

text: It was the smell was so was so bad,
ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz ðə smˈɛl wˈɑz sˈoʊ wˈɑz sˈoʊ bˈæd/
vi: Mùi đó thật kinh khủng,

text: I I literally had to cover my my mouth and my nose.
ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈaɪ lˈɪtɚəli hˈæd tˈu kˈʌvɚ mˈaɪ mˈaɪ mˈaʊθ ənd mˈaɪ nˈoʊz/
vi: Tôi thực sự phải che miệng và mũi của mình.

text: That's how bad it it was.
ipa: /ðˈæts hˈaʊ bˈæd ˈɪt ˈɪt wˈɑz/
vi: Mọi chuyện tệ đến mức đó.

text: The company that owns the tank says it contains glycidyl methacrylate,
ipa: /ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ðˈæt ˈoʊnz ðə tˈæŋk sˈɛz ˈɪt kəntˈeɪnz glycidyl methacrylate/
vi: Công ty sở hữu bồn chứa cho biết nó chứa glycidyl methacrylate,

text: an industrial chemical used to help make certain plastics, paints, and coatings.
ipa: /ˈæn ˌɪndˈʌstɹiəl kˈɛməkəl jˈuzd tˈu hˈɛlp mˈeɪk sˈɝtən plˈæstɪks pˈeɪnts ənd kˈoʊtɪŋz/
vi: một hóa chất công nghiệp được sử dụng để sản xuất một số loại nhựa, sơn và chất phủ.

text: Health officials say exposure can irritate the eyes, skin, and respiratory system.
ipa: /hˈɛlθ əfˈɪʃəlz sˈeɪ ɪkspˈoʊʒɚ kˈæn ˈɪɹɪtˌeɪt ðə ˈaɪz skˈɪn ənd ɹˈɛspɚətˌɔɹi sˈɪstəm/
vi: Các quan chức y tế cho biết việc tiếp xúc có thể gây kích ứng mắt, da và hệ hô hấp.

text: The city's mayor says the exposure is not expected to cause a lasting health disturbance.
ipa: /ðə sˈɪtiz mˈeɪɚ sˈɛz ðə ɪkspˈoʊʒɚ ˈɪz nˈɑt ɪkspˈɛktəd tˈu kˈɑz ə lˈæstɪŋ hˈɛlθ dɪstˈɝbəns/
vi: Thị trưởng thành phố cho biết việc phơi nhiễm này không được dự kiến sẽ gây ra rối loạn sức khỏe kéo dài.

text: Officials say the leak was due to a quote error
ipa: /əfˈɪʃəlz sˈeɪ ðə lˈik wˈɑz dˈu tˈu ə kwˈoʊt ˈɛɹɚ/
vi: Các quan chức cho biết rò rỉ là do lỗi trích dẫn

text: that occurred when the material was being transferred.
ipa: /ðˈæt əkˈɝd wˈɛn ðə mətˈɪɹiəl wˈɑz bˈiɪŋ tɹænsfˈɝd/
vi: đã xảy ra khi vật liệu đang được chuyển giao.

text: As of this taping, first responders, hazmat,
ipa: /ˈæz ˈʌv ðˈɪs tˈeɪpɪŋ fˈɝst ɹɪspˈɑndɚz hazmat/

text: and safety teams hadn't been approaching the tank in case there would be more explosions.
ipa: /ənd sˈeɪfti tˈimz hˈædənt bˈɪn əpɹˈoʊtʃɪŋ ðə tˈæŋk ɪn kˈeɪs ðˈɛɹ wˈʊd bˈi mˈɔɹ ɪksplˈoʊʒənz/

text: And here's your knowledge drop some chemicals that are stable
ipa: /ənd hˈɪɹz jˈɔɹ nˈɑlədʒ dɹˈɑp sˈʌm kˈɛmɪkəlz ðˈæt ˈɑɹ stˈeɪbəl/

text: as liquids can become far more dangerous if they heat up,
ipa: /ˈæz lˈɪkwədz kˈæn bɪkˈʌm fˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ dˈeɪndʒɚəs ˈɪf ðˈeɪ hˈit ˈʌp/

text: vaporize, or react unexpectedly, which is why emergency crews aren't just fighting
ipa: /vˈeɪpɚˌaɪz ˈɔɹ ɹiˈækt ˌʌnɪkspˈɛktɪdli wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz wˈaɪ ɪmˈɝdʒənsi kɹˈuz ˈɑɹənt dʒˈʌst fˈaɪtɪŋ/

text: what they can see, they're monitoring what's in the air.
ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈeɪ kˈæn sˈi ðˈɛɹ mˈɑnətɚɪŋ wˈʌts ɪn ðə ˈɛɹ/

text: In the past 5 months, there have been evacuations, even deaths,
ipa: /ɪn ðə pˈæst 5 mˈʌnθs ðˈɛɹ hˈæv bˈɪn ɪvˌækjəwˈeɪʃənz ˈivɪn dˈɛθs/

text: across the US after chemical leaks or explosions in Southern California,
ipa: /əkɹˈɔs ðə ˈʌs ˈæftɚ kˈɛməkəl lˈiks ˈɔɹ ɪksplˈoʊʒənz ɪn sˈʌðɚn kˌæləfˈɔɹnjə/

text: Washington State, and a recycling plant also in Toledo just 2 months ago.
ipa: /wˈɑʃɪŋtən stˈeɪt ənd ə ɹisˈaɪkəlɪŋ plˈænt ˈɔlsoʊ ɪn təlˈidoʊ dʒˈʌst 2 mˈʌnθs əɡˈoʊ/

text: Pop quiz, hotshot what country is the world's largest coffee producer?
ipa: /pˈɑp kwˈɪz hˈɑʃˌɑt wˈʌt kˈʌntɹi ˈɪz ðə wˈɝldz lˈɑɹdʒəst kˈɑfi pɹədˈusɚ/

text: Brazil, Indonesia, Colombia, or Ethiopia?
ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˌɪndoʊnˈiʒə kəlˈʌmbiə ˈɔɹ ˌiθiˈoʊpiə/

text: If you said Brazil, you are no average Joe.
ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu sˈɛd bɹəzˈɪl jˈu ˈɑɹ nˈoʊ ˈævɚɪdʒ dʒˈoʊ/

text: Brazil produces roughly 1/3 of the world's coffee,
ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl pɹədˈusəz ɹˈʌfli 13 ˈʌv ðə wˈɝldz kˈɑfi/

text: and if you like sugar in yours, they've got you covered there, too.
ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈu lˈaɪk ʃˈʊɡɚ ɪn jˈʊɹz ðˈeɪv ɡˈɑt jˈu kˈʌvɚd ðˈɛɹ tˈu/

text: Brazil is also the world's biggest producer of sugarcane.
ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˈɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ðə wˈɝldz bˈɪɡəst pɹədˈusɚ ˈʌv ʃˈʊɡɚkˌeɪn/

text: Millions of workers in Brazil, Latin America's largest economy,
ipa: /mˈɪljənz ˈʌv wˈɝkɚz ɪn bɹəzˈɪl lˈætən əmˈɛɹəkəz lˈɑɹdʒəst ɪkˈɑnəmi/

text: are getting something many people around the world would love an extra day off.
ipa: /ˈɑɹ ɡˈɛtɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ mˈɛni pˈipəl ɚˈaʊnd ðə wˈɝld wˈʊd lˈʌv ˈæn ˈɛkstɹə dˈeɪ ˈɔf/

text: As Brazil heads to the polls this weekend to elect their next president,
ipa: /ˈæz bɹəzˈɪl hˈɛdz tˈu ðə pˈoʊlz ðˈɪs wˈikˌɛnd tˈu ɪlˈɛkt ðˈɛɹ nˈɛkst pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt/

text: the nation's Senate has voted to reduce the country's work week from 6 days to 5,
ipa: /ðə nˈeɪʃənz sˈɛnət hˈæz vˈoʊtɪd tˈu ɹədˈus ðə kˈʌntɹiz wˈɝk wˈik fɹˈʌm 6 dˈeɪz tˈu 5/

text: from 44 hours to 40, without reducing pay.
ipa: /fɹˈʌm 44 ˈaʊɚz tˈu 40 wɪθˈaʊt ɹədˈusɪŋ pˈeɪ/

text: It's Brazil's largest labor reform in decades,
ipa: /ˈɪts bɹəzˈɪlz lˈɑɹdʒəst lˈeɪbɚ ɹəfˈɔɹm ɪn dɛkˈeɪdz/

text: and is expected to affect more than 35 million workers.
ipa: /ənd ˈɪz ɪkspˈɛktəd tˈu əfˈɛkt mˈɔɹ ðˈæn 35 mˈɪljən wˈɝkɚz/

text: Brazil is following a growing trend across Latin America after Mexico,
ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˈɪz fˈɑloʊɪŋ ə ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ tɹˈɛnd əkɹˈɔs lˈætən əmˈɛɹəkə ˈæftɚ mˈɛksəkˌoʊ/

text: Chile, and Colombia recently passed similar laws to cap hours and benefit workers.
ipa: /tʃˈɪli ənd kəlˈʌmbiə ɹˈisəntli pˈæst sˈɪməlɚ lˈɔz tˈu kˈæp ˈaʊɚz ənd bˈɛnəfɪt wˈɝkɚz/

text: The move is seen as a big legislative win for incumbent President Lula da Silva,
ipa: /ðə mˈuv ˈɪz sˈin ˈæz ə bˈɪɡ lˈɛdʒəslˌeɪtɪv wˈɪn fˈɔɹ ˌɪnkˈʌmbənt pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt lˈulə dˈɑ sˈɪlvə/

text: who's currently seeking a fourth non-consecutive term.
ipa: /hˈuz kˈɝəntli sˈikɪŋ ə fˈɔɹθ nonconsecutive tˈɝm/

text: He's currently locked in a tight race with Senator Flavio Bolsonaro,
ipa: /hˈiz kˈɝəntli lˈɑkt ɪn ə tˈaɪt ɹˈeɪs wˈɪð sˈɛnətɚ flˈɑvioʊ bolsonaro/

text: the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, who Lula defeated in 2022.
ipa: /ðə sˈʌn ˈʌv fˈɔɹmɚ pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt jair bolsonaro hˈu lˈulə dɪfˈitəd ɪn 2022/

text: The two face off in a runoff election this Sunday.
ipa: /ðə tˈu fˈeɪs ˈɔf ɪn ə ɹˈʌnˌɔf ɪlˈɛkʃən ðˈɪs sˈʌndˌeɪ/

text: You've probably heard of Apple's newest phone.
ipa: /jˈuv pɹˈɑbəblˌi hˈɝd ˈʌv ˈæpəlz nˈuəst fˈoʊn/

text: Officially launching tomorrow, the tech giant isn't just upgrading it is folding it in half.
ipa: /əfˈɪʃəli lˈɔntʃɪŋ təmˈɑɹˌoʊ ðə tˈɛk dʒˈaɪənt ˈɪzənt dʒˈʌst əpɡɹˈeɪdɪŋ ˈɪt ˈɪz fˈoʊldɪŋ ˈɪt ɪn hˈæf/

text: The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable smartphone,
ipa: /ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ ˈɪz ˈæpəlz fˈɝst foldable smˈɑɹtfˌoʊn/

text: but some might say it comes with about 2,000 problems.
ipa: /bˈʌt sˈʌm mˈaɪt sˈeɪ ˈɪt kˈʌmz wˈɪð əbˈaʊt 2000 pɹˈɑbləmz/

text: First, it cost 2,000 bucks.
ipa: /fˈɝst ˈɪt kˈɑst 2000 bˈʌks/

text: And what about the engineering challenges?
ipa: /ənd wˈʌt əbˈaʊt ðə ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹɪŋ tʃˈæləndʒɪz/

text: How do you make a screen bend thousands of times without cracking?
ipa: /hˈaʊ dˈu jˈu mˈeɪk ə skɹˈin bˈɛnd θˈaʊzəndz ˈʌv tˈaɪmz wɪθˈaʊt kɹˈækɪŋ/

text: But could its design make it more useful or just more expensive?
ipa: /bˈʌt kˈʊd ˈɪts dɪzˈaɪn mˈeɪk ˈɪt mˈɔɹ jˈusfəl ˈɔɹ dʒˈʌst mˈɔɹ ɪkspˈɛnsɪv/

text: Apple gave CNN's Lisa Eadicicco one to take for a test fold.
ipa: /ˈæpəl ɡˈeɪv sˈiˈɛnˈɛnz lˈisə eadicicco wˈʌn tˈu tˈeɪk fˈɔɹ ə tˈɛst fˈoʊld/

text: This does feel sort of like an iPad, but not quite.
ipa: /ðˈɪs dˈʌz fˈil sˈɔɹt ˈʌv lˈaɪk ˈæn ˈaɪpˌæd bˈʌt nˈɑt kwˈaɪt/

text: This is the iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable iPhone.
ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ ˈæpəlz fˈɝst foldable ˈaɪfˌoʊn/

text: And this is a really big deal for Apple
ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə ɹˈɪli bˈɪɡ dˈil fˈɔɹ ˈæpəl/

text: because it's the first time the iPhone has had a significant change like
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪts ðə fˈɝst tˈaɪm ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn hˈæz hˈæd ə səɡnˈɪfɪkənt tʃˈeɪndʒ lˈaɪk/

text: this in its nearly 20-year history.
ipa: /ðˈɪs ɪn ˈɪts nˈɪɹli 20year hˈɪstɚi/

text: So, I thought the Duo was going to feel more awkward,
ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ θˈɔt ðə dˈuoʊ wˈɑz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu fˈil mˈɔɹ ˈɑkwɚd/

text: but it's really about the same size as a passport.
ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts ɹˈɪli əbˈaʊt ðə sˈeɪm sˈaɪz ˈæz ə pˈæspˌɔɹt/

text: And just for comparison, this is the latest foldable from Samsung,
ipa: /ənd dʒˈʌst fˈɔɹ kəmpˈɛɹəsən ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə lˈeɪtəst foldable fɹˈʌm sˈæmsˌʌŋ/
